powers: When you encounter a card, a character at your location may discard a card; if she does, evade your encounter.

roles.name: Poisoner
powers: When you encounter a card, a character at your location may discard (☐ or recharge) a card; if she does, evade your encounter.
You (☐ or a character at your location) may discard a card to add 1d4 (☐ +1) (☐ +2) to a combat check by a character at another location.

When you play a boon that has the Poison (☐ or Corrupted) trait, you may ignore that trait and/or immunities to it. If the boon would required you to bury any cards from your hand or deck, recharge them instead. (☐ If the boon is played on your check, add 1d4.)
☐ You gain the skill Arcane equal to your Fortitude skill.
☐ You gain the skill Melee equal to your Ranged skill.
☐ Reduce all Poison damage dealt to you by 2 (☐ 4).

roles.name: Red Mantis Assassin
powers: When you encounter a card, a character at your (☐ or any) location may discard a card; if she does, evade your encounter (☐ or you may add 1d6 to your combat checks against the encountered card).
You may discard a card to add 1d4 (☐ +1) (☐ +2) (☐ +3) to a combat check by a character at another location.

When you play a boon that has the Poison (☐ or Corrupted) trait, you may ignore that trait and/or immunities to it. If the boon would required you to bury any cards from your hand or deck, recharge them instead.

☐ For your combat check, you may discard a weapon to use your Dexterity skill + 2d10 and add the Poison and Vermin traits. If the weapon is a Sawtooth Sabre +2 (☐ or has the Poison trait), recharge it instead.
☐ At the end of your (☐ or any) turn, you may banish a card to shuffle 1d4+1 random cards from the discard pile of a character at your location into your deck.
